items.title: Do I need to bring my own mat?
items.description: We provide premium Manduka mats for all students at no extra charge, though you are welcome to bring your own.

items.title: Is breathwork safe for beginners?
items.description: Absolutely. Our Somatic Breathwork classes are designed to be accessible for all levels, with modifications provided.

items.title: What is your cancellation policy?
items.description: Classes must be cancelled at least 12 hours in advance to avoid a late-cancel fee or loss of credit.

items.title: Do you have showers?
items.description: We have spacious changing rooms and a tea lounge, but we do not have shower facilities at this location.
